adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: In the Void, Yuriko serves Cassandra Nova, and when the Resistance storms Nova's lair she fights Logan claw for claw.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: One of Nova's henchmen. Fights Logan in the Void.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Battles Yuriko when the Resistance storms Nova's lair.
adds.evidence: During the Resistance's assault on Cassandra Nova's lair in the Void, Lady Deathstrike engages in a fight with Wolverine before Blade and Elektra take her on.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Dopinder comes to Wade's surprise birthday party and tells him a story about AirPods left in his cab. He joins Wade's friends again for dinner once the danger is over.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The cabbie at Wade's birthday party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend whose birthday party Dopinder attends.
adds.evidence: Dopinder attends Wade's surprise birthday party in 2024 and tells Wade and Shatterstar a story about AirPods found in his cab; later dinner with Wade's friends, Logan and Laura.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Wade lives with Al again, and at his birthday party she nags him about the rent and offers him cocaine. After the fight with the Deadpool Corps, he brings Logan and Dogpool home to meet her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's roommate again. Nags him about the rent.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Al's roommate again. Brings Logan and Dogpool home.
adds.evidence: Wade moved back in with Blind Al after breaking up with Vanessa; at his birthday party she asks about rent and offers cocaine; after the Deadpool Corps fight he introduces her to Wolverine and Dogpool.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Colossus comes to Wade's surprise birthday party, and the two chat about what he's watching on TV.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An X-Man and guest at Wade's birthday party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend whose birthday party Colossus attends.
adds.evidence: Colossus attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party; Wade asks what he's watching and he answers The Great British Bake Off; later dinner with Wade's friends.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: At Wade's surprise birthday party, Negasonic teases him about his obvious toupee.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Teases Wade about his toupee at his party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Negasonic teases about his toupee.
adds.evidence: Negasonic attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party and comments on his obvious toupee, which he claims is a balayage.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Yukio comes to Wade's surprise birthday party with Negasonic and tells him she likes his toupee.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend whose toupee Yukio likes.
adds.evidence: Yukio attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party with Negasonic; the two talk with Wade about his toupee, which Yukio likes.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Shatterstar, alive again, comes to Wade's surprise birthday party and listens with him to Dopinder's story about AirPods left in a cab.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's old team. Shatterstar comes to his birthday party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: X-Force's founder, whose birthday party Shatterstar attends.
adds.evidence: Shatterstar attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party and, with Wade, listens to Dopinder's AirPods story; he later joins the dinner with Wade's friends. No other X-Force member in the node appears.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Buck comes to Wade's surprise birthday party, and Wade cuts him off every time he tries to speak.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A biker pal at Wade's birthday party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The friend who keeps cutting Buck off.
adds.evidence: Buck attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party; Wade stops him when he tries to speak and shoots him down for improvising during the speech.

adds.title: Deadpool 2
adds.text: Weasel tries to comfort the grieving Wade at Sister Margaret's, then helps him hold auditions to build X-Force.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Wade audition recruits for X-Force.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The grieving friend Weasel helps build X-Force.
adds.evidence: After Vanessa's death Weasel tries to comfort Deadpool drinking at Sister Margaret's; Deadpool organizes X-Force with Weasel, who holds auditions with him.

adds.title: Deadpool 2
adds.text: Dopinder begs Wade for a place in his line of work and drives him, Domino and Cable to the orphanage. He runs over the abusive headmaster there, to Wade's approval.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Drives Wade to the orphanage. Runs over the headmaster.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Dopinder drives to the orphanage.
adds.evidence: Dopinder wants to follow Deadpool into contract killing and asks to join X-Force; he drives Deadpool, Domino and Cable to the Essex House and runs over the headmaster, earning Deadpool's approval.

adds.title: Deadpool 2
adds.text: Colossus takes Negasonic, now in full X-Men uniform, and his new trainee Wade to answer the standoff at the orphanage.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Colossus at the orphanage standoff.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Negasonic on the orphanage call.
adds.evidence: Deadpool joins the X-Men and, together with Colossus and Negasonic Teenage Warhead, responds to the standoff with Russell at the orphanage.

owner_calls.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
owner_calls.question: The X-Force node lists Bedlam, Shatterstar, Zeitgeist and the Vanisher. Only Shatterstar appears in Deadpool & Wolverine (at Wade's party). Keep the proposed X-Force stage on the strength of Shatterstar alone, or give Shatterstar his own node?
options: Split Shatterstar into his own node
owner_calls.evidence: Shatterstar attends Wade's 2024 birthday party; no other node member appears.
